issues.title: Subtab bar wraps on narrow views
issues.expected: Horizontal scrolling sub-tab navigation on narrow screens
issues.actual: Tab list wraps vertically causing header layout shift
issues.recommendedFix: Apply overflow-x-auto to the tab containers style sheet
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Nav items render in a single scrollable row on responsive view

issues.title: No keyboard exit handle on detail drawer
issues.expected: Pressing ESC closes the active drawer
issues.actual: Must manually click close button or overlay to close
issues.recommendedFix: Attach global keydown event listener on ESC key
issues.acceptanceCriteria: Active drawer closes on ESC press
